sentences.text:
on 5 June, 2025
Author: Vivek Singh Thakur

Bench: Vivek Singh Thakur
Ravi Kumar Vs. Nic and others.
Fao (Mva) No. 370 of 2024 5.6.2025 Present: Ms.Muskan and Ms.Anita, Advocates, vice
Mr.Vidushi Sharma, Advocate, for the appellant.

Respondent No. 1 already ex pare vide order dated 22.3.2025 passed by Additional Registrar (Judicial).
Mr.Avinash Jaryal, Advocate, for respondents No. 2 to 5.
FAO (MVA) No. 370 of 2024 Admit.
Respondents No. 2 to 5 are duly represented, therefore, no post admission notices are required to be issued to these respondents.

Post admission notice, returnable on next date, on taking steps within one week, be issued to respondent No. 1.
List for further orders on 4th August, 2025.

Subject to deposit of share of compensation amount payable by appellant alongwith up to date interest thereon, in the Registry of this Court on or before 31 st July, 2025, execution and operation of impugned award dated 4.7.2024 passed by MACT Chamba in CIS Registration No. 81 of 2021, qua appellant/owner Ravi Kumar shall remain stayed during pendency of the appeal.
It is made clear that non deposit of amount in aforesaid terms shall result into automatic vacation of interim protection.

5th June, 2025 (Keshav)
Ravi Kumar vs . Nic And Others.
